purpose: Human review chain for the first intentionally curated public proof corpus. Selection is committed; approval decisions and notes remain local until a human explicitly publishes or records a disposition.
guardrails: The review kit never changes review to published automatically.
Approve requires all required checks and a non-empty human review note.
The synthesis publish command is unavailable until every source insight is actually published.
A local approve record is not publication provenance; the existing publish scripts remain the only publication transition.
Hold or do_not_publish dispositions require a note so intentional non-publication has an auditable local reason.
Review previews remain noindex,nofollow and are not added to public discovery surfaces by this plan.
